scope: Graphical notebook opening, repaired serialization, complete fresh-kernel execution, and the retained results of the earlier mathematical audit.

conventions.curve_degrees: Degrees of P(z,W), with W the resolvent, unless a scaling coordinate is explicitly specified; shifted auxiliary curves can have different z-degrees.
conventions.sheet_count: Generic algebraic sheet count of the recorded curve. Null denotes a scaling calculation without a complete sheet-expansion audit.
conventions.moduli: Correlator coefficients remain symbolic boundary data unless an exact trace identity determines them.

generic_assumptions: Planar formal Schwinger-Dyson equations and normalized traces.
Nonzero denominators and generic couplings away from discriminant and degree-dropping loci.
Simple leading roots where a Taylor recurrence uses an implicit-function expansion; ramified families use their stated fractional-power branches.
Consistent choices of fractional powers, including the positive-coupling branch conventions used in the displayed expansions.
Cyclic trace identities always apply; reversal and spin-permutation reductions apply only when the action and measure possess those symmetries.

verification_methods.symbolic_curve_comparison: Exact equality of complete polynomials after trace identities and a nonzero normalization factor.
verification_methods.newton_remainder: Exact symbolic substitution and Newton-polygon remainder bounds for the displayed expansion.
verification_methods.taylor_recurrence: Exact coefficient recurrence at a generic simple leading root; this is not a blanket full-curve Newton check.
verification_methods.historical_replay: Fresh evaluation of the specified original calculation through its terminal curve.
verification_methods.full_notebook_execution: Every Input and Code cell evaluated in order in a fresh licensed Wolfram kernel, preserving output history. Actual outputs and messages are recorded and hashed; saved notebook outputs are never used as inputs.
verification_methods.frontend_opening: NotebookOpen called in the actual graphical Mathematica frontend on a byte-identical copy of every active notebook; each opens successfully and contains the expected input cells.
verification_methods.notebook_serialization: Materialize deferred MakeBoxes calls and save valid literal notebook data. Preserve input boxes, text, and styles; separately repair the single corrupted fixed-Potts input.

Fresh execution means every current input cell ran. Mathematical proof and independent derivation have the narrower scope stated for each case; older mathematical checks are preserved under their original date and hashes.
Some symbolic eliminations take minutes or longer. The fresh-kernel timings are measurements on this machine, not runtime guarantees.
Generic algebraic curves and formal asymptotics do not globally determine physical correlator moduli, integration contours, or critical scaling regimes.
An independent direct loop-equation elimination for dilute Potts fixed remains unresolved; its recorded curve uses an exact analytic identity.
The weighted-boundary notebook computes the physical asymptotics and four moments; it does not list all twelve sheets.
Special parameter loci can change polynomial degree, sheet multiplicity, or expansion type and require separate analysis.
